evidence_scope: Primary-paper abstracts and the official IH-Challenge research page were reviewed using web tools. This is not full-paper reproduction, released-dataset audit, source-license clearance, or evidence of a Titan effect.
benchmark_policy: Design inspiration only. Do not import public benchmark rows, answers or close paraphrases into TRAIN. Any later import requires source/revision/rights review and contamination exclusion inventories.

sources.title: RULER: What's the Real Context Size of Your Long-Context Language Models?
sources.supported_design: Separate needle retrieval, multi-hop tracing and aggregation; vary length and task complexity.
sources.caveat: A synthetic evaluation taxonomy does not prove general document understanding or predict Titan's performance.

sources.title: BABILong: Testing the Limits of LLMs with Long Context Reasoning-in-a-Haystack
sources.supported_design: Reason over multiple facts distributed through long text; include induction, deduction, counting and set/list operations.
sources.caveat: Synthetic fact insertion can differ from realistic source distributions. No reported recurrent-memory result qualifies the local dense Titan runtime.

sources.title: NoLiMa: Long-Context Evaluation Beyond Literal Matching
sources.supported_design: Include questions and evidence with minimal lexical overlap; test associative reasoning separately from literal matching.
sources.caveat: Low overlap can introduce outside-knowledge dependence. Supply necessary definitions when testing contextual rather than pretrained knowledge.

sources.title: LongBench v2: Towards Deeper Understanding and Reasoning on Realistic Long-context Multitasks
sources.supported_design: Cover single/multiple documents, long contextual learning, dialogue history, code repositories and structured data.
sources.caveat: Its public multiple-choice questions are evaluation material. Their lengths and difficulty are not a ready-made training curriculum for a 596M model.

sources.title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
sources.supported_design: Counterbalance early, middle, late and distributed evidence positions; compare the same semantics at different positions.
sources.caveat: The studied QA and key-value tasks do not cover all long-context mechanisms. Position effects must be measured on the actual student.

sources.title: Long-context LLMs Struggle with Long In-context Learning
sources.supported_design: Vary demonstration length, label-space complexity and demonstration position independently in contextual skill tasks.
sources.caveat: Extreme-label classification is one ICL setting. Do not infer general contextual learning or a Titan capacity threshold from it.

sources.title: Many-Shot In-Context Learning
sources.supported_design: Investigate learning from additional demonstrations and unfamiliar mappings; keep task performance separate from next-token loss.
sources.caveat: Reported benefits in studied larger models do not establish benefits for Titan. Teacher rationales require independent factual/semantic verification.

sources.title: Instruction-Following Evaluation for Large Language Models
sources.supported_design: Use independently executable output constraints and report strict instruction compliance.
sources.caveat: Format compliance does not prove answer correctness, grounding, hierarchy resolution or broad usefulness.

sources.title: The Instruction Hierarchy: Training LLMs to Prioritize Privileged Instructions
sources.supported_design: Train priority-aware instruction handling and distinguish privileged instructions from untrusted embedded text.
sources.caveat: The actual dataset policy and native role serialization must be specified. Quoted role names are not real message roles.

sources.title: IH-Challenge: A Training Dataset to Improve Instruction Hierarchy on Frontier LLMs
sources.supported_design: Avoid conflating hierarchy and difficult instruction failures; use simple objectively graded tasks and controls against overrefusal shortcuts.
sources.caveat: Its frontier-model online training results do not authorize the local RL route, predict a Titan gain, or prove retention.

sources.title: Improving instruction hierarchy in frontier LLMs
sources.reviewed_portion: approach, grading pitfalls, task principles and stated limitations/results
sources.supported_design: Make hierarchy tasks instruction-following-simple, objectively gradable and resistant to trivial always-refuse solutions.
sources.caveat: An official research summary is not an independent replication. Its published capability table should not be treated as a universal no-regression guarantee.

sources.title: LongAlign: A Recipe for Long Context Alignment of Large Language Models
sources.supported_design: Study long instruction data at lengths comparable to intended use while assessing short generic tasks.
sources.caveat: Its packing/sorted batching recipe is outside the currently qualified no-packing CE512 contract; native long training requires a new scope.

inference_status: Curriculum choices are proposals. Intelligence acquisition and preservation effects require registered student comparisons.
